# libabigail suppression rules for the ABI compatibility workflow.
#
# Replacing four private GL-context SbHash members with SbSmallMap stops the
# compiler from emitting their destructors. Suppress only those exact Itanium
# ABI symbols instead of all SbHash instantiations.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjP16SoGLShaderObjectED[12]Ev$
  label = Private SoGLShaderObject context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjmED[12]Ev$
  label = Private shader program-handle context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN6SbHashIjjED[12]Ev$
  label = Private uniform-parameter context-map destructor replaced by SbSmallMap; it is not part of Coin's public ABI.

# SoUniformShaderParameterP is defined only inside
# src/shaders/SoShaderParameter.cpp. Changing its private map member can alter
# whether its out-of-line destructor is emitted, but clients cannot name or use
# the class.

[suppress_function]
  symbol_name_regexp = ^_ZN25SoUniformShaderParameterPD[12]Ev$
  label = SoUniformShaderParameterP is a source-file-private implementation class; its destructor is not part of Coin's public ABI.
